comparison.objective: Candidate removes a terminal; record installs a click-lock floor tile.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate probes beneath a recessed tab and pulls wire and blade together; record bimanually angles a large tongue into a groove and lowers the tile to engage the joint.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires selective undamaged extraction; record requires both seam ends locked, controlled lippage, correct wall gap, release, and pull resistance.
comparison.reason: Large-part angle-and-lower joint engagement differs from miniature latch release and depinning.
